description: Data-driven guide definitions for WordPress client documentation generator

screenshot_rules.ensure_visibility: Before taking a screenshot, ensure all UI elements referenced in the step's guide_text and expected_label are visible. This includes: (1) hovering to reveal hover-dependent elements like WordPress row actions, (2) scrolling the referenced element into the viewport, (3) waiting for animations/transitions to complete.
screenshot_rules.pre_screenshot_actions: Steps may include an optional 'pre_screenshot' field with actions to execute before the screenshot. These are hints — the capture agent should also use its judgment to ensure referenced elements are visible even when no pre_screenshot is specified.
screenshot_rules.scroll_into_view: If the step's target element or the element referenced in guide_text is below the fold, scroll it into view before taking the screenshot. Use browser_evaluate with element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }).

wp_login.title: How to Log into WordPress
wp_login.description: Step-by-step guide to accessing your WordPress admin dashboard

steps.expected_label: WordPress login page loads with username and password fields
steps.guide_text: Open your browser and go to **{site_url}/wp-admin**. You'll see the WordPress login page.

steps.expected_label: Username and password fields filled (password masked before screenshot)
steps.guide_text: Enter your **username** and **password** in the fields provided.
steps.safety: MASK password field value before taking screenshot

steps.expected_label: WordPress dashboard loads after successful login
steps.guide_text: Click the **Log In** button. You'll be taken to your WordPress dashboard.

edit_text.title: How to Edit Text on a Page
edit_text.description: How to find and edit text content on any page of your website using the WordPress editor

safety.notes: Test edit must be undone. NEVER click Update/Save.

steps.expected_label: WordPress dashboard with Pages menu visible in left sidebar
steps.guide_text: From your WordPress dashboard, look at the left sidebar menu.

steps.expected_label: Pages list loads showing all site pages with row actions visible
steps.guide_text: Click **Pages** in the left sidebar. You'll see a list of all your website's pages.

pre_screenshot.purpose: Reveal row actions (Edit, Quick Edit, Trash, View) so the Edit option referenced in the next step is visible

steps.expected_label: Page editor opens (Gutenberg block editor or Classic editor)
steps.guide_text: Hover over the page you want to edit and click **Edit**. The page editor will open.

steps.expected_label: Text block is selected and editable
steps.guide_text: Click on any text block to select it. You'll see a cursor appear.

steps.expected_label: Test text typed into the text block
steps.guide_text: Type your changes. The text updates in real-time.

steps.expected_label: Update/Save button is visible in the editor
steps.guide_text: When you're happy with your changes, click the **Update** button to save.

steps.expected_label: Test edit reverted via Ctrl+Z, page is clean
steps.guide_text: You can preview your page using the **View Page** link before or after saving.
steps.safety: UNDO test edit with Ctrl+Z. Do NOT click Update/Save.

change_image.title: How to Change a Page Image
change_image.description: How to replace a content image on a page using the WordPress block editor

safety.notes: Image swap must be undone. NEVER click Update/Save.

steps.expected_label: Page open in WordPress block editor with at least one image visible
steps.guide_text: Open a page that has an image you want to change. From the Pages list, hover over the page and click **Edit**. The block editor will open.

steps.expected_label: Image block is selected with block toolbar visible above it
steps.guide_text: Click on the image you want to change. You'll see a toolbar appear above the image block.

steps.expected_label: Replace dropdown showing Upload, Media Library, and URL options
steps.guide_text: In the toolbar above the image, click **Replace**. You'll see options to upload a new image or choose from the Media Library.

steps.expected_label: Media Library dialog opens showing available images
steps.guide_text: Click **Open Media Library** to browse your uploaded images. Click the image you want to use, then click **Select**.

steps.expected_label: New image is visible on the page in the editor
steps.guide_text: The image on your page will update immediately. Review the change to make sure it looks right.

steps.expected_label: Update button visible in the editor top bar
steps.guide_text: When you're happy with the new image, click the **Update** button to save your change.
steps.safety: UNDO image replacement with Ctrl+Z. Do NOT click Update/Save.

publish_blog.title: How to Publish a Blog Post
publish_blog.description: How to create and publish a new blog post on your website

safety.undo_method: Cancel publish flow, then move draft to Trash
safety.notes: Draft must be trashed. NEVER click the final Publish confirmation.

steps.expected_label: Posts menu with Add New Post button visible
steps.guide_text: In the left sidebar, click **Posts**. You'll see a list of your blog posts and an **Add New Post** button at the top.

steps.expected_label: Block editor with title field, block inserter, and settings gear
steps.guide_text: Click **Add New Post**. The block editor opens with a title field at the top, a content area below, and a settings gear in the top right.

steps.expected_label: Slash command block inserter dropdown showing block types
steps.guide_text: Click in the content area and type **/** to see a list of available blocks (paragraph, heading, image, list, etc.). Select a block type to add it.

steps.expected_label: Post sidebar showing Featured Image section and Categories
steps.guide_text: In the right sidebar under **Post**, you'll find **Featured Image** (your post's thumbnail) and **Categories** (how your post is organized). Click the settings gear if the sidebar isn't visible.

steps.expected_label: Publish button in the editor top bar
steps.guide_text: When your post is ready, click the **Publish** button in the top-right corner.

steps.expected_label: Publish confirmation panel with final Publish button
steps.guide_text: A confirmation panel appears. Review the settings, then click **Publish** to make your post live.
steps.safety: Do NOT confirm publish. Cancel the publish flow, then move test draft to Trash.

featured_image.title: How to Set a Featured Image
featured_image.description: How to set or change the featured image (thumbnail) for a page or post

safety.undo_method: Remove featured image before leaving editor
safety.notes: Set a test featured image, then remove it. Never click Update.

steps.expected_label: Page or post open in the WordPress editor with right sidebar visible
steps.guide_text: Open any page or post in the editor. In the left sidebar, click **Pages** (or **Posts**), then hover over the item you want and click **Edit**.

steps.expected_label: Featured Image panel visible in the right sidebar
steps.guide_text: In the right sidebar, scroll down to find the **Featured Image** section. If the sidebar isn't visible, click the **Settings** gear icon in the top-right corner.

pre_screenshot.purpose: Scroll the Featured Image panel into view in the sidebar

steps.expected_label: Media Library dialog opens for image selection
steps.guide_text: Click **Set featured image**. The Media Library will open, showing your uploaded images.

steps.expected_label: An image is selected and featured image thumbnail appears in sidebar
steps.guide_text: Click the image you want to use, then click **Set featured image** at the bottom. You'll see a thumbnail preview in the sidebar.
steps.safety: Select any existing image for demonstration. Do NOT upload new images.

steps.expected_label: Featured image removed, panel shows Set featured image button again
steps.guide_text: When you're happy with your featured image, click **Update** to save the change.
steps.safety: REMOVE the test featured image by clicking 'Remove featured image'. Do NOT click Update.

update_seo.title: How to Update SEO
update_seo.description: How to update your page's SEO title and meta description for search engines

safety.notes: View-only. Do NOT edit any SEO fields.

steps.expected_label: Page editor open with content visible
steps.guide_text: Open any page in the editor (follow the **How to Edit Text** guide to get there).

steps.expected_label: SEO plugin panel visible below editor or in sidebar
steps.guide_text: Scroll down below the editor content to find your SEO settings panel.

steps.expected_label: SEO title field visible with current value
steps.guide_text: Find the **SEO Title** field. This is what appears as the clickable headline in Google search results.

steps.expected_label: Meta description field visible with current value
steps.guide_text: Find the **Meta Description** field. This is the short summary shown below your title in search results.

steps.expected_label: Google search preview snippet showing title and description
steps.guide_text: Look at the **Google Preview** section to see how your page will appear in search results.

steps.expected_label: Update button visible. Do NOT click it.
steps.guide_text: After making your SEO changes, click the **Update** button to save.
steps.safety: Do NOT modify any SEO fields. This is view-only for screenshots.

edit_text_lc.title: How to Edit Text on a Page (LiveCanvas)
edit_text_lc.description: How to find and edit text content on any page using the LiveCanvas editor

safety.undo_method: Ctrl+Z in LiveCanvas, then exit without saving
safety.notes: Test edit must be undone. NEVER click Save in LiveCanvas.

steps.expected_label: WordPress dashboard with Pages menu visible in left sidebar
steps.guide_text: From your WordPress dashboard, look at the left sidebar menu.

steps.expected_label: Pages list loads showing all site pages with row actions visible
steps.guide_text: Click **Pages** in the left sidebar. You'll see a list of all your website's pages.

pre_screenshot.purpose: Reveal row actions (Edit, Edit with LiveCanvas, Trash, View) so the Edit with LiveCanvas option is visible

steps.expected_label: LiveCanvas editor opens with the page content loaded
steps.guide_text: Hover over the page you want to edit and click **Edit with LiveCanvas**. The LiveCanvas visual editor will open.

steps.expected_label: Text element is selected and editable in LiveCanvas
steps.guide_text: Click on any text element to select it. A blue outline will appear around it and you can start typing.

steps.expected_label: Test text typed into the text element
steps.guide_text: Type your changes. The text updates in real-time on the page.

steps.expected_label: LiveCanvas Save button visible in the editor toolbar
steps.guide_text: When you're happy with your changes, click the **Save** button in the LiveCanvas toolbar to publish.

steps.expected_label: Test edit reverted via Ctrl+Z, page is clean
steps.guide_text: You can exit the editor by clicking the **X** button or navigating back to the Pages list.
steps.safety: UNDO test edit with Ctrl+Z. Do NOT click Save in LiveCanvas.

change_image_lc.title: How to Change a Page Image (LiveCanvas)
change_image_lc.description: How to replace a content image on a page using the LiveCanvas editor

safety.undo_method: Ctrl+Z in LiveCanvas editor, then close without saving
safety.notes: Image swap must be undone in LiveCanvas. NEVER click Save in LC.

steps.expected_label: Page open in LiveCanvas editor with at least one image visible
steps.guide_text: Open a page that has an image you want to change. From the Pages list, hover over the page and click **Edit with LiveCanvas**. The visual editor will open.

steps.expected_label: Image element is selected in LiveCanvas, showing the Image settings panel in the sidebar
steps.guide_text: Click on the image you want to change. The **Image** settings panel will appear in the left sidebar.

steps.expected_label: Image panel shows current image source with Replace/Upload options
steps.guide_text: In the sidebar panel, you'll see options to change the image. Click **Replace Image** or **Choose from Library** to pick a new image.

steps.expected_label: Media library or Unsplash browser opens showing available images
steps.guide_text: Browse your uploaded images in the Media Library, or search for free stock photos via Unsplash (if available). Click the image you want to use.

steps.expected_label: New image is visible on the page in the LiveCanvas editor
steps.guide_text: The image on your page will update immediately. Review the change to make sure it looks right.

steps.expected_label: LiveCanvas Save button is visible in the editor toolbar
steps.guide_text: When you're happy with the new image, click the **Save** button in the LiveCanvas toolbar to publish your change.
steps.safety: UNDO image replacement with Ctrl+Z. Do NOT click Save in LiveCanvas.
